item.title: A Visit to Kyiv to Mark Ukraine’s 35 Years of Independence
item.description: On this anniversary, the Ukrainian people’s enduring hope and resolve remain a source of inspiration.

item.title: Trump: U.S. has entered deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
item.description: President Donald Trump announced on Friday that the U.S. has reached an agreement with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of the South American country’s oil reserves.

item.title: How the Trump Administration Is Reimagining Civil-Rights Enforcement
item.description: Its assertive strategy distinguishes it from previous Republican administrations.

item.title: On the Election Case, Take the Supreme Court Justices at Their Word
item.description: Their commitment to the judicial role prevents them from suggesting the president will misuse his power, but if he does, they will respond firmly.
